# AI Workspace HQ
> Customer AI deployment you can check, step by step.

AI Workspace HQ (aiworkspacehq.com) helps organisations put AI on one repeated job at a time, through a 12-step process where every step leaves a receipt you can open and check. Founded by Manish Patel in India; serves global clients. Operated by Kartavya CSC Digital Seva (sole proprietorship).
